text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Some time after Chairwoman Akikawa
took off for America—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Knock knock)

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Good work.
I'm here to share the details regarding the "Aoharu Cup."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
First, let's do a quick recap
of the Aoharu Cup, just in case.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
As Chairwoman Akikawa explained the other day,
the Aoharu Cup is an intra-academy team competition.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
It is held twice a year, in late June and late December.
Your first race will be in late December of this year.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The condition for victory is competing across 5 categories:
Sprint, Mile, Medium, Long, and Dirt,
and winning 3 categories—meaning 3 races.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: And then, in the Aoharu Cup, a preseason is held first, with rankings assigned based on those results.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Once the preseason is over, the finals will finally begin!
The ultimate outcome will be determined by the race results in the finals.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
First, let's do our best to aim
for a higher rank in the pre-season!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
However, in order to participate in the Aoharu Cup,
we must gather team members.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. To start with...
I think it would be good to talk to the members
who will support your training!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
That's right, recruiting members is allowed
during the preseason as well.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
If you perform well in the preseason races,
other Umamusume might take an interest in joining our team!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Please gather members and create a wonderful team.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: And finally, just one more important thing.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
"When registering to enter the Aoharu Cup,
you will need a team name."

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Although it's a team name only used within the Academy
and not in the Twinkle Series—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
A good name boosts team morale.
Please, take your time and think it over carefully.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
With that, I will be quietly
praying for your success.
